definitions.gloss: gradually; little by little; step by step
definitions.explanation: Indicates a gradual change or progression over time. Often used with verbs describing change of state.

examples.japanese: {段々|だんだん}と⟦{暖|あたた}かく→暖かい：00618_atatakai⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧きた。
⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{段々|だんだん}と⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧になっている。
examples.english: Your Japanese is getting better little by little.

examples.japanese: ⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{段々|だんだん}と⟦{暗|くら}く→暗い：00647_kurai⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧、⟦やがて→やがて：03637_yagate⟧⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}り{始|はじ}めた→降り始める：22638_furihajimeru⟧。
examples.english: The sky gradually grew darker, and before long it started to rain.

notes:
{段々|だんだん}と expresses gradual change over time. The particle ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ is often omitted in casual speech, giving {段々|だんだん} alone.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {段々|だんだん}（と）〜てくる: to gradually come to ~ (approaching the present)
- {段々|だんだん}（と）〜ていく: to gradually go on to ~ (moving away from the present)
- {段々|だんだん}（と）〜⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to gradually become ~

EXAMPLE PATTERN:
{段々|だんだん}と⟦{分|わ}かって→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧きた (I gradually came to understand).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{徐々|じょじょ}→徐々：03082_jojo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: gradually (more formal, written style)
- ⟦{次第|しだい}→次第：03175_shidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: gradually (emphasizes sequential progression)
- ⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧: little by little (focuses on small increments)
- {段々|だんだん} is the most common and natural in everyday conversation
